{{Top}}
{{MoreSources}}
[[File:DexsDinerKitchen-FF54.png|thumb|250px|right|Foodstuffs being prepared in the kitchen of [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]]]]
{{Quote|Food&mdash;and drinks&mdash;are part of the life support system, so don't worry about the passengers.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quasar (Human)|Quasar]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 24">[[Star Wars (1977) 24|''Star Wars'' (1977) 24]]</ref>}}
'''Foodstuffs''' were the raw material of food. Organic creatures needed food to sustain themselves, and [[Endothermy|endothermic]] beings used the energy in their food to keep their body temperature constant.<ref name="SWSA">''[[Star Wars Science Adventures: Journey Across Planet X]]''</ref> Groceries were basic foodstuffs and commodities on [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]] that could be carried in a basic grocery bag.<ref name="PtaR">''[[Star Wars: Prelude to Rebellion]]''</ref>
